decisions.decision: Keep the AABB test as a PADDED pre-filter, not a verdict.
decisions.why: Unpadded it discards exactly the near-miss pairs the clearance check exists to find. Padding by the largest active rule keeps it honest. Pinned by test_the_aabb_prefilter_must_pad_by_the_clearance_or_it_hides_violations.

decisions.decision: A hard clash cites no rule; a clearance finding MUST cite one.
decisions.why: Interpenetration is a clash under every rule, so inventing a citation for it would be false precision. Clearance is only meaningful against a stated requirement.

decisions.decision: Elements with no usable geometry are reported UNJUDGED, never CLEAR.
decisions.why: Silence is not a pass. A report that calls an unexamined zone clean is the failure mode this kit exists to remove.

decisions.decision: Every finding carries the METHOD that produced it (exact_boolean / surface_intersection / min_distance).
decisions.why: Without the manifold3d backend or a watertight mesh, contact can be proven but penetration depth cannot. A consumer ranking by severity must know which it has.
